units.title: probably/likely/maybe/perhaps
units.shortDescription: Вероятно, возможно, наверное — четыре степени уверенности.
units.theoryHtml:
СловоВероятностьМесто
probably~80% «вероятно»перед глаголом / после be: It will probably rain. He's probably asleep.
likely~70% «вероятно»be likely to: It's likely to rain. He's likely to be late.
maybe/perhaps~50% «может быть»в начале: Maybe he forgot. Perhaps she's right.

probably — не в начале предложения: Probably it will rain → It will probably rain. likely — конструкция с be: He is likely to win.

maybe — одно слово (наречие), may be — два слова (глагол): Maybe he's at home = He may be at home.

⚠ Частые ошибки: It's probably to rain → It will probably rain / It's likely to rain. Maybe he will comes → comes без -s.

Мини-диалог:
— Will it snow tomorrow? — It'll probably snow. — And the concert? — It's likely to be cancelled. Maybe they'll move it inside.

exercises.prompt: He'll ___ be late — he always is.
She's ___ to win the race.
___ he's stuck in traffic.

Choose the correct sentence:
exercises.explanation: probably перед will... точнее между will и rain.

exercises.prompt: ___, the train was cancelled.

He's ___ ___ (вероятно будет) angry. (2-3 слова: likely to be)

units.title: both...and / not only...but also
units.shortDescription: И то и другое; не только... но и — парные союзы.
units.theoryHtml:
Парные союзы соединяют ОДИНАКОВЫЕ части речи:

ПараПример
both ... andShe speaks both English and French.
not only ... but alsoHe's not only smart but also kind.
either ... orTake either the bus or the metro.
neither ... norNeither the bus nor the metro runs at night.

Правило параллельности: то, что после первой части, должно совпадать по типу со второй: not only to read but also to write (не ...but also writing!).

Инверсия (для эмфазы, формально): Not only does he sing, but he also plays the guitar.

⚠ Частые ошибки: both A as well as B → both A and B. not only...but (без also — допустимо разговорно, учебно — but also). После both...and глагол мн.ч.: Both he and she are doctors.

Мини-диалог:
— I hear you speak both German and Italian? — Yes, and I'm learning Spanish too.Not only do you learn fast, but you also collect languages like stamps!

He's ___ talented ___ hardworking.
___ the manager ___ the director signed it.

Choose the correct sentence:
options: She likes not only swimming but also to run.

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ he late, but he also forgot the documents.
exercises.explanation: Инверсия: Not only was he late.

exercises.prompt: Both Tom and his sister ___ musicians.

units.title: would для привычек в прошлом
units.shortDescription: Every summer we would go to the sea — альтернатива used to.
units.theoryHtml:
would + инфинитив описывает повторяющиеся действия в прошлом — как used to: Every summer we would go to the sea. My grandfather would tell us stories every night.

Ключевое ограничение: would — только ДЕЙСТВИЯ, не состояния! We used to have a dog ✓, но We would have a dog ✗ (состояние). I used to live in Rome ✓ (состояние), I would live ✗.

СитуацияЧто использовать
привычка-действиеused to / would
состояние в прошломтолько used to
разовое событиеPast Simple

⚠ Частые ошибки: I would be shy → I used to be shy. He would own a boat → He used to own a boat.

Мини-диалог:
— Tell me about your childhood. — Every winter we would skate on the lake. My father would build a fire on the shore.
— And did you live there? — We used to have a small house nearby.

exercises.prompt: Every summer we ___ to the sea.
My grandma ___ us stories every evening.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: I would be shy at school.
I used to be shy at school.
I would been shy at school.

exercises.prompt: He ___ long walks in the morning.
We ___ a big garden back then. (имели — состояние)
Choose the correct sentence:
options: She used to own a bakery.
She use to own a bakery.

exercises.prompt: On Sundays, dad ___ pancakes for everyone.
Разовое событие в прошлом:
options: We used to visit Rome in 2010.

exercises.prompt: Every winter it ___ ___ (снег шел) for weeks. (would + snow)
We ___ ___ (жили) in a tiny flat then. (состояние, 2-3 слова)
